# Neopolis Akademy

> Multilingual practical AI training, professional use cases, career pathways and certification preparation for Tunisia, Africa and the MENA region. Public information is available in French, English and Arabic; learner progress, assessments, answers and administration remain private.

## Canonical public resources

- [Home](https://akademy.neodev.click/): programme overview and public FAQ.
- [AI News](https://akademy.neodev.click/ai-news): curated links to public AI news sources.
- [AI News RSS](https://akademy.neodev.click/ai-news/rss.xml): machine-readable feed of the latest curated source links.
- [Sitemap index](https://akademy.neodev.click/sitemap-index.xml): exhaustive public canonical URL inventory.
- [Machine-readable catalogue](https://akademy.neodev.click/ai-index.json): structured JSON summary of public programmes, courses, topics and career pathways.
- [Extended LLM context](https://akademy.neodev.click/llms-full.txt): detailed public catalogue in Markdown.

## Français

- [Training by professional domain](https://akademy.neodev.click/formations-ia): 116 programmes, 180 courses and 3454 learning activities.
- [Public training catalogue](https://akademy.neodev.click/formations-ia/catalogue): canonical public pages for every training programme and course.
- [Golden Jobs](https://akademy.neodev.click/formations-ia/golden-jobs): AI career profiles linked to relevant learning paths.
- [Comptabilité & Finance](https://akademy.neodev.click/formations-ia/comptabilite-finance): Formations IA gratuites pour la comptabilité, la facturation, le contrôle de gestion et l’analyse financière.
- [Informatique & Développement](https://akademy.neodev.click/formations-ia/informatique-developpement): Formations IA gratuites pour développer des applications, des agents, des systèmes RAG et des intégrations API.
- [Data, BI & Recherche](https://akademy.neodev.click/formations-ia/data-bi-recherche): Formations IA gratuites pour l’analyse de données, le reporting, la BI, la recherche et les décisions documentées.
- [Administratif & RH](https://akademy.neodev.click/formations-ia/administratif-ressources-humaines): Formations IA gratuites pour le secrétariat, la coordination, les opérations et les ressources humaines.
- [Commerce, Marketing & Client](https://akademy.neodev.click/formations-ia/commerce-marketing-relation-client): Formations IA gratuites pour la prospection, le CRM, le contenu, le support client et les opérations e-commerce.
- [Juridique & Conformité](https://akademy.neodev.click/formations-ia/juridique-conformite): Formations IA gratuites pour les contrats, la conformité, l’analyse de risques et les opérations juridiques.
- [Stratégie & Transformation](https://akademy.neodev.click/formations-ia/strategie-transformation-ia): Formations IA gratuites pour la gouvernance, la stratégie, les processus et la mise en œuvre responsable de l’IA.
## English

- [Training by professional domain](https://akademy.neodev.click/en/ai-training): 116 programmes, 180 courses and 3454 learning activities.
- [Public training catalogue](https://akademy.neodev.click/en/ai-training/catalogue): canonical public pages for every training programme and course.
- [Golden Jobs](https://akademy.neodev.click/en/ai-training/golden-jobs): AI career profiles linked to relevant learning paths.
- [Accounting & Finance](https://akademy.neodev.click/en/ai-training/comptabilite-finance): Free AI training for accounting, invoicing, management control and financial analysis.
- [IT & Development](https://akademy.neodev.click/en/ai-training/informatique-developpement): Free AI training to build applications, agents, RAG systems and API integrations.
- [Data, BI & Research](https://akademy.neodev.click/en/ai-training/data-bi-recherche): Free AI training for data analysis, reporting, BI, research and evidence-based decisions.
- [Administration & HR](https://akademy.neodev.click/en/ai-training/administratif-ressources-humaines): Free AI training for secretarial work, coordination, operations and human resources.
- [Sales, Marketing & Customer](https://akademy.neodev.click/en/ai-training/commerce-marketing-relation-client): Free AI training for prospecting, CRM, content, customer support and e-commerce operations.
- [Legal & Compliance](https://akademy.neodev.click/en/ai-training/juridique-conformite): Free AI training for contracts, compliance, risk analysis and legal operations.
- [Strategy & Transformation](https://akademy.neodev.click/en/ai-training/strategie-transformation-ia): Free AI training for governance, strategy, processes and responsible AI implementation.
## العربية

- [Training by professional domain](https://akademy.neodev.click/ar/ai-training): 116 programmes, 180 courses and 3454 learning activities.
- [Public training catalogue](https://akademy.neodev.click/ar/ai-training/catalogue): canonical public pages for every training programme and course.
- [Golden Jobs](https://akademy.neodev.click/ar/ai-training/golden-jobs): AI career profiles linked to relevant learning paths.
- [المحاسبة والمالية](https://akademy.neodev.click/ar/ai-training/comptabilite-finance): تدريب مجاني في الذكاء الاصطناعي للمحاسبة والفوترة والرقابة الإدارية والتحليل المالي.
- [تقنية المعلومات والتطوير](https://akademy.neodev.click/ar/ai-training/informatique-developpement): تدريب مجاني في الذكاء الاصطناعي لبناء التطبيقات والوكلاء وأنظمة RAG وعمليات تكامل API.
- [البيانات وذكاء الأعمال والبحث](https://akademy.neodev.click/ar/ai-training/data-bi-recherche): تدريب مجاني في الذكاء الاصطناعي لتحليل البيانات والتقارير وذكاء الأعمال والبحث والقرارات المستندة إلى الأدلة.
- [الإدارة والموارد البشرية](https://akademy.neodev.click/ar/ai-training/administratif-ressources-humaines): تدريب مجاني في الذكاء الاصطناعي للأعمال المكتبية والتنسيق والعمليات والموارد البشرية.
- [المبيعات والتسويق والعملاء](https://akademy.neodev.click/ar/ai-training/commerce-marketing-relation-client): تدريب مجاني في الذكاء الاصطناعي للتنقيب وCRM والمحتوى ودعم العملاء وعمليات التجارة الإلكترونية.
- [القانون والامتثال](https://akademy.neodev.click/ar/ai-training/juridique-conformite): تدريب مجاني في الذكاء الاصطناعي للعقود والامتثال وتحليل المخاطر والعمليات القانونية.
- [الاستراتيجية والتحول](https://akademy.neodev.click/ar/ai-training/strategie-transformation-ia): تدريب مجاني في الذكاء الاصطناعي للحوكمة والاستراتيجية والعمليات والتنفيذ المسؤول للذكاء الاصطناعي.

## Usage and boundaries

- Public pages may be crawled and cited with their canonical URLs.
- Training facts and links are generated from the published catalogue.
- Do not infer access to private lessons, learner progress, assessment answers, corrections, credentials or personal data.
- Career and salary references are learning guidance, not employment or compensation promises.
- Prefer the same-language canonical page when answering in French, English or Arabic.
